name: WEEKDAY
description: WEEKDAY returns the day of the week as a number from a date, with the return_type argument controlling how days are numbered (for example Sun-Sat 1-7 or Mon-Sun 1-7).
tldr: Returns the day-of-week number for a date.

parameters.name: return_type
parameters.description: Optional. Controls numbering: 1 (default) = Sunday=1 to Saturday=7; 2 = Monday=1 to Sunday=7; 3 = Monday=0 to Sunday=6; 11-17 select a specific start day (11=Mon start ... 17=Sun start).

basicExample.description: Day of week for New Year 2024
basicExample.explanation: 2024-01-01 is a Monday. With the default return_type 1 (Sunday=1), Monday is 2.

advancedExamples.title: Monday-based numbering
advancedExamples.explanation: With return_type 2 (Monday=1 to Sunday=7), Monday returns 1.

advancedExamples.title: Zero-based Monday numbering
advancedExamples.explanation: With return_type 3 (Monday=0 to Sunday=6), Monday returns 0.

howItWorks: WEEKDAY computes the day of the week from the date serial using modulo-7 arithmetic, then maps the result to a number according to return_type. The default (1) treats Sunday as the first day (1) and Saturday as the last (7).

howToSteps.name: Enter the date
howToSteps.text: Provide a date serial or a DATE(...) expression.

howToSteps.name: Choose return_type
howToSteps.text: Pick 1, 2, 3, or 11-17 to control the numbering.

howToSteps.name: Read the weekday number
howToSteps.text: The function returns a number you can use in logic or formatting.

limitations: return_type must be one of 1, 2, 3, or 11-17; other values return #NUM!.
The time portion of a date-time serial does not affect the weekday.
It works only for dates Excel supports (1900-01-01 onward).

commonErrors.cause: An invalid return_type value was supplied.
The date argument is text Excel cannot parse.
commonErrors.fix: Convert the text to a real date serial first.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: WEEKDAY works identically in Google Sheets and supports the same return_type values 1, 2, 3, and 11-17.

faq.question: How do I make Monday equal 1?
What does return_type 3 do?
faq.answer: It numbers Monday as 0 and Sunday as 6.

faq.question: Can I start the week on a different day?
faq.answer: Yes, return_type 11-17 let you pick the start day, e.g. 16 starts Friday.
